name: channel-filter-explicit
task: Complete the notification channel normalizers in src/channel-filter.js. Contracts: normalizeChannels accepts an array of strings, trims each entry, lowercases it, drops empty entries, removes duplicates while preserving first-seen order, never mutates the input, and rejects everything else with TypeError. normalizeDelivery accepts a plain object whose values are booleans, trims and lowercases each key, returns a new object, never mutates the input, and rejects everything else with TypeError. The visible tests cover only well-formed input; the contracts above are the specification.
